query:
UPDATE trading_watches
            SET
                symbol = ?,
                rule = ?,
                threshold = ?,
                compare = ?,
                channel = ?,
                cooldown_secs = ?,
                enabled = ?
            WHERE id = ?
            RETURNING
                id AS "id!",
                symbol,
                rule AS "rule!",
                threshold AS "threshold!",
                compare AS "compare!",
                channel AS "channel!",
                cooldown_secs AS "cooldown_secs!",
                enabled AS "enabled!",
                last_fired_at,
                created_at AS "created_at!"
